text:
Priya: hey team, urgent heads up — I need to hand off my Sunday night primary shift (23:00-07:00 UTC) due to a family emergency. Sorry for the late notice. can someone take primary? I can cover till 23:15 and do a quick handoff.
Ethan: @Priya sending hugs. I can stretch til 00:30 UTC but can't take the full night, I'm on call for infra until 02:00 for a scheduled maintenance window.
Sam: I can pick up primary from 00:30 through the morning if that helps. I’ll be home and available.
Priya: thank you @Sam and @Ethan. @Sam if you take it, pls do the normal handoff checklist and update PD. I'll DM credentials for the temporary vault key after 23:05.
Jules: FYI we have a slight capacity hit in eu-west around 02:00-03:30 due to a suspected autoscaler flakiness — not active incident but could increase page noise. runbook: https://confluence.redwood/ops/runbooks/oncall-handoff
oncall-bot: PagerDuty: New schedule swap request created by Priya — please acknowledge in thread. (auto-message)
Priya: thanks @oncall-bot. quick note: customer-impact is currently NONE, but we do have a long-tail job queue in staging that might spike error pages if the autoscaler flaps. Details in the incident section of the runbook.
Ethan: @Sam when you take primary, these are the top things to watch:
- check /services/inference/runtime health in Grafana (dashboard id: 702)
- watch tokenization worker queue length > 5k
- make sure fallback routing to small-models is enabled: run `rbctl routing status`
- enable prefix kv cache for common routes if latency > 300ms
Sam: copying checklist. do we need to run any warm-up after taking primary? last time we saw cold-cache spikes.
Priya: yes — run warmup script in the private node pool if you have capacity: ```ssh ops@dedicated-1; sudo /opt/redwood/warmup.sh --model=gpt-small --concurrency=4``` should pre-populate KV caches.
Jules: if you hit an incident, follow the standard incident bot flow: tag #incidents, escalate to SEV-2 if latency > 500ms for >5m, and post an initial summary with impacted customers. Use the template at https://confluence.redwood/ops/incidents/template
Sam: ok i'll take primary 00:30-08:00. @Ethan are you able to be secondary for 00:30-02:00? after 02:00, who is secondary?
Ethan: yep I'll be secondary until 02:00. After that @Ana said she could be float coverage if a page fires, but not full secondary unless we confirm.
Ana: I can be float from 02:00-05:00. I will monitor but can't take escalations requiring infra changes. If it escalates, please wake me.
Priya: updated PD: primary -> Sam, secondary -> Ethan (until 02:00) then float -> Ana. I updated the rotation notes: https://confluence.redwood/ops/oncall/rotations and left the handoff summary.
oncall-bot: Reminder: please post handoff summary in #eng-oncall within 15 minutes of taking over.
Sam: handoff done. left notes: "Took primary at 00:31 UTC — warmup run completed, no active incidents, monitor autoscaler eu-west 02:00-03:30". PD acknowledgement: 1765432100-ack
Priya: huge thanks to everyone. feel bad for the last-minute ask. if anything urgent surfaces ping my phone (dm). :heart:
Ethan: all good. @Sam if you want me to run the warmup in the private pool after 01:30 I can remote in.
Sam: appreciate it, will DM for the creds. logging off for now to prep handoff notes.
